observation: Complete House CAO Q2 publication through native source-bound migration and two real external accounting tools

preparation_receipt.date_policy: Use a nonblank published TRANSACTION DATE only when it falls inside the publication quarter. A blank GL TRANSACTION DATE is assigned the quarter's last day solely for this analysis book. Original blanks and service-period dates remain unchanged in retained evidence. Service dates never substitute for transaction dates; no monthly distribution of undated payroll is inferred. A malformed service-date literal remains unparsed with an explicit diagnostic. Published two-digit years are interpreted as 2000 through 2099 in this source.
preparation_receipt.entry_group_policy: At most 12 nonzero source rows with one analysis effective date; deterministic analysis grouping, not original journal membership.
preparation_receipt.header_policy: Only header padding is stripped for field keys. Complete original headers and field bytes remain in the pinned raw publications.
preparation_receipt.model_boundary: An expenditure analysis book of the complete selected published organization. Each nonzero DETAIL amount maps to an Expense account for its exact program and category, with an explicit modeled Equity counterpart. These are not the House's original journals, cash balances, opening balances, or full general ledger. Summary and subtotal rows are controls only, never monetary inputs. No original debit/credit counterpart, fiscal-year accrual, or undisclosed appropriation identity is inferred.
preparation_receipt.native_validation: UNRUN: preparation and publisher controls do not establish native accounting execution.

preparation_receipt.record_digest_policy: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON containing original header strings and decoded field strings; not a raw byte-slice hash.
preparation_receipt.section_policy: Publication sections are numbered in the original order within one exact organization and end at its printed OFFICE TOTALS. Corresponding detail and summary sections must agree on their complete category, program, and office controls. Repeated labels in separate sections remain distinct controls and are aggregated only for the explicitly declared program/category accounts. A repeated control key within a section is refused as ambiguous.
preparation_receipt.source_identity_policy: Original file SHA-256 and CSV record ordinal identify each row. Document IDs and identical fields are never deduplicated.
